title: Election Commission of India's Special Summary Revision (SSR) 2027: integrated draft electoral rolls due 12 Nov 2026 in 13 states and 3 UTs (Andaman and Nicobar, Assam, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Goa, Gujarat, Kerala, Lakshadweep, Madhya Pradesh, Manipur, Puducherry, Punjab, Rajasthan, Tamil Nadu, Uttarakhand, West Bengal); claims and objections until 11 Dec, disposal by 28 Dec, final rolls 4 Jan 2027, qualifying date 1 Jan 2027 (ECI order of 15 Oct). Uttar Pradesh's draft moved to 17 Nov with claims 17 Nov-16 Dec (ECI approved 6 Nov; UP CEO Navdeep Rinwa, 10 Nov). Form 6 inclusion (SIR-deleted names can reapply, per DT Next and The South First), Form 7 objection/deletion, Form 8 correction/shift; advance applications for those turning 18 by 1 Apr/1 Jul/1 Oct 2027. Six more states/UTs (Arunachal, Chandigarh, DNH & DD, Mizoram, Odisha, Sikkim): draft by 30 Nov, final 21 Jan 2027. Publication on 12 Nov not independently confirmed at post time: copy says 'due'.
